attributes.name: Abeyance
attributes.powers: Discard this card to banish a card that has the Curse trait displayed next to the deck of a character at your location.
attributes.recharge:
After playing this card, if you do not have the Divine skill, banish this card; otherwise, discard it, or you may succeed at a Divine 7 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.

If you have the Divine skill, you may recharge this card when you reset your hand.

corrections.corrected_text: On the spell Abeyance, change "banish a bane that has the Curse trait" to "banish a card that has the Curse trait".
corrections.issue: Abeyance lets me get rid of banes that have the Curse trait. So I can't use it on the scourges in Mummy's Mask, since they're support cards?
